summary.intent: Run the GSD `/gsd-plan-phase 70.1` and `/gsd-execute-phase 70.1` workflows for CipherBox to produce and then execute PLAN.md files for Phase 70.1 (rotation read-plane durability + crash-resume soundness), using wave-based parallel execution with independent git worktrees for concurrent plans.
summary.outcome: Planning completed with 13 plans across 7 waves after two user-driven scope expansions (Rust engine.rs twin, then desktop FUSE RotationDeps live-wiring); execution merged Waves 1-6 cleanly (including fixing a genuine product bug the D-10 anti-vacuous e2e gate caught: decrypt-before-dirtiness-check ordering in the rotation engine, fixed in both TS and Rust), but Wave 7's desktop-e2e plan surfaced that `refresh_sent_shares()` is never wired into the desktop mount lifecycle, so the new D-15a fail-closed gate returns EIO on every real desktop delete/rename — session ended mid-clarification with the user before a fix-now-vs-defer decision was made.

repo: GSD decision-coverage parser (.claude/gsd-core/bin/lib/decisions.cjs) accepts only three D-NN bullet forms; a `- **D-NN (title).** body` (period before closing **) form silently fails to parse and blocks the whole gate at 0/N covered
GSD commit helper can report `commit_failed` as a false negative when lint-staged just runs long (e.g. on large ROADMAP.md) — always verify with `git log`, never blind-retry
`gsd_run loop render-hooks plan:pre --raw` emits invalid JSON (literal newlines in fragments) — read the hooks file directly instead
`state.planned-phase` / STATE-update tools can silently no-op (`updated: []`) if STATE.md's frontmatter/section anchors don't match what the tool expects — requires manual edit
Worktree agents doing `cargo fmt --all` (unscoped) strand unrelated files as uncommitted drift and block `cleanup-wave` merges with `worktree_dirty`; must scope fmt to `-p <crate>`
After merging a wave that touched a package other packages depend on (e.g. sdk-core), the main checkout's stale `dist/` causes false test failures in dependent packages (sdk) until dists are rebuilt
`apps/web/*.test.ts` files are not run by CI (web is web-e2e-gated only) — logic needing CI coverage should live in `packages/sdk` behind an injectable storage/IDB seam, not in the web app

`tests/sdk-e2e` vitest config has no dotenv loader and its `test` script is bare `vitest run` — `.env` (incl. `TEST_LOGIN_SECRET`) must be sourced into the shell manually or the harness silently falls back to a default secret and gets 401

CipherBox's rotation scope-exit gate keys off `sent shares` (direct user-to-user grants, `GET /shares/sent`), not `share-invites` (unclaimed link-based invites) — only active grants need the revocation-lever rotation
CipherBox delete is a soft-delete (moves to the private recycle bin), which is structurally a move-out-of-shared-scope — that's why it triggers rotation even though it looks like a delete

Same-folder rename does NOT trigger scope-exit rotation (gate only fires when parent != newparent in rename.rs); rotation is forward-looking only and doesn't retroactively revoke already-published/cached ciphertext

`CipherBoxFS::refresh_sent_shares()` has zero call sites anywhere in the repo — desktop mount (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/fuse/mod.rs) seeds `sent_shares` to `SentSharesCache::empty()` at mount and never refreshes it, so it stays non-authoritative forever

`crates/fuse/src/platform/windows/write_ops.rs` has an independent duplicate of the gate-ordering pattern that Rust fixes (D-15d) don't reach, and it can't even be `cargo check`ed on macOS (winfsp-sys needs Windows COM APIs) — a real WinFsp-parity gap

code.finding: collectDirtyFrontier/resolveChildKeyAndEnvelope AEAD-decrypted a child's sealed ref with the parent's current key BEFORE checking plaintext generation for dirtiness, causing CryptoError on any genuinely-dirty edge whose parent also rotated in the same walk; fixed by reordering the plaintext check first and pushing dirty items with nodeReadKey: undefined for repairDirtyNode to resolve via the ECIES checkpoint
rotate_read_on_scope_exit originally a stub returning Err (fail-closed EIO) — Plan 09 wired it to the new production FuseRotationDeps adapter
unused NodeKind import left over from merged 03/09 edits; removed as post-merge cleanup

sent_shares cache seeded to SentSharesCache::empty() at mount construction with no periodic or init-time refresh; combined with Plan 11's fail-closed D-15a fix, every desktop delete/rename now returns EIO regardless of private vs shared

workflow: When dispatching parallel worktree agents, fire each `git worktree add`-triggering Agent call in its own message/turn to avoid a `.git/config.lock` race; they still run truly concurrently once created

Running the first plan of a wave synchronously as a canary to validate the worktree→commit→merge cycle is reasonable given prior merge-failure scars, but must be explicitly communicated to the user as intentional, not silently done — user had to ask why only 1/4 plans was running
When a decision-coverage or plan-checker gate fails with a parse-shaped error, diagnose the parser/regex directly rather than assuming a real coverage gap

Delegate suspicious e2e failures to a scientific-method debugging subagent with an explicit instruction to distinguish 'fixture bug' (fix it) from 'product bug' (report precisely, don't hack green) — this correctly surfaced a real latent engine bug instead of a masked fixture issue

Generic post-merge build/test gates default to root `npm test`, which is mis-tuned for a mixed pnpm+cargo monorepo (heavy, pulls in docker-dependent suites) — use targeted per-package/per-crate commands matching VALIDATION.md instead

Treat rust-analyzer/LSP-reported compile errors as provisional; confirm with the actual `cargo check`/`cargo test` compiler output before spending time chasing what may be a stale-index false positive

friction: User had to correct the assistant for silently running only 1 of 4 Wave-1 plans as an unannounced canary instead of the requested full concurrency
render-hooks --raw produced invalid JSON, requiring a workaround (reading the file directly)
Decision-coverage gate blocked entirely (0/15) due to a cosmetic D-09/D-10 bullet-format mismatch predating this session's edits
state.planned-phase tool silently no-op'd instead of updating STATE.md, requiring manual edit
Wave 1 merge blocked mid-flight by unscoped cargo fmt drift from plan 03's worktree
Cross-package dist staleness caused 3 false test failures after Wave 3 merge, requiring a rebuild-and-rediagnose detour
sdk-e2e suite failed with a 401 at setup due to missing .env sourcing, masking as an auth bug before being traced to a config/env-loading gap
A rust-analyzer stale diagnostic (macros.rs AncestorChain type mismatch) caused a false-alarm investigation before being dismissed against the authoritative compiler
A tracking commit hit the 2-minute Bash timeout on the large ROADMAP.md's lint-staged hook, requiring verification via git log rather than retry

Wave 7's plan-13 agent surfaced a critical, previously-unknown integration gap (never-refreshed sent_shares cache) only at the very last plan of a 13-plan phase, after 12 plans were already merged — a late-discovered blocker
Multiple rounds of AskUserQuestion were deflected/re-asked as the user probed the rotation semantics and mount-init gap before committing to a decision, leaving the session open-ended
